responsibility: Implements the RTL data dependence graph used by instruction scheduling, especially modulo/software pipelining over loops. It builds DDG nodes for basic-block instructions and dependence edges for register and memory true/anti/output dependencies, computes edge latency and iteration distance, tracks loop-closing-branch dependencies and memory-access classification, and provides graph algorithms such as predecessor/successor reachability, path filtering, backarc handling, and strongly connected component decomposition with recurrence-length calculation for scheduling heuristics.
same_name_distinction: Implements the ddg interface by constructing and analyzing RTL dependence graphs and SCCs for scheduling; unlike gcc/ddg.h, it contains the executable graph-building, dependence classification, path search, and recurrence-length algorithms rather than the DDG type and API declarations.
